sources.title: AI Image Detector — Check If Any Image Is AI Generated | idetect.org
sources.snippet: How Does This AI Image Detector Work? Our AI image detection engine uses a multi-layer neural network trained on millions of real and synthetic images. It analyzes pixel-level noise patterns, GAN fingerprints, frequency artifacts, and metadata inconsistencies to determine whether an image was created by a human or an AI model like Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or Flux.
